item.title: Stolen horse recovered after Spring Valley standoff; suspect arrested
item.description: "Deputies located the suspect a short distance away from the location. Upon contact, the suspect ran away with the stolen horse."

item.title: San Diego-born Robert Duvall, Oscar-winning actor and ‘Godfather’ mainstay, dead at 95
item.description: Famed for iconic roles in "Godfather" and "Apocalypse Now," Duvall was born in San Diego in 1931 to his Navy admiral father.

item.title: West Coast levee failures show rising risks from aging flood defenses
item.description: Across the U.S., levees are getting older while weather is getting more extreme. Many were never designed for the enormous responsibility they now carry.

item.title: SDSU student-athletes provide a helping hand to local pets
item.description: Last Saturday, SDSU student-athletes spent part of their Valentine’s Day providing love and care to animals sheltered at the Humane Society.

item.title: More than 140 flights delayed at San Diego Airport as storm brings heavy wind, rain
item.description: More that 140 flights into and out of San Diego International Airport were delayed Monday as high winds and heavy rain moved through the county, according to online flight-tracking data.

item.title: Last call for handmade hearts to uplift San Diego women living with HIV
item.description: There is one week left to submit heart-shaped artwork for From the HeART, Townspeople’s fourth annual community art installation uplifting women living with HIV in San Diego County.

item.title: Hot covers, cool jazz, new genres: Top shows this week
item.description: Next-level cover bands, nineties indie folk-pop darlings, and the possible birth of a brand-new genre in the San Diego music scene this week.

item.title: Desmond calls for review of social service fraud safeguards after California scandals
item.description: San Diego County Supervisor Jim Desmond announced a formal request Monday for county staff to deliver a public presentation on efforts to prevent, detect and respond to fraud in the county’s social service programs. Desmond said he sent a memo to County Chief Administrative Officer Ebony Shelton asking for a public presentation by county staff. […]

item.title: Seven things to do in and around the Point
item.description: Here are seven events in Point Loma, Liberty Station, and Ocean Beach that should help keep off the SAD (Seasonal Affective Disorder).

item.title: San Diego Fire-Rescue officials urge ‘smart actions’ during storm this week
item.description: Heavy rain and gusty winds moved through San Diego County Monday, leading fire crews to stage swiftwater rescue teams as a precaution, though officials said most calls were for traffic accidents.
